title: Body Double
text: “What, what?”
“Vof?”
“Whoa, Spear Hero’s glomping onto Filo! Someone call Shield Hero!”
Some sort of commotion rose up around me, but I had finally—finally—gotten my hands on the real Filo-tan. Fufufu… I had at last broken through Rafumi’s blockade, I say.
“What are you doing…”
“Luna won’t lose eitherー”
“Luna! Get off me! Stop rubbing your cheek against me!”
“And what exactly are you doing over there?”
Itsuki’s voice rang out with exasperation as he watched Luna-chan hugging Ren the same way I was hugging Filo, and he repeated the very same line to her.
“M-Motoyasu-kun!? And Filo!?”
“Master! Waaah, the spear guy latched onto me! I can’t get him off! He won’t come off!”
“Um, Rafumi-chan?”
“What?”
Rafumi revealed herself at last.
“Weren’t you supposed to be protecting Filo from Motoyasu-kun?”
“Ah, the danger period has passed, so the body double duty is concluded.”
“‘No danger’? Filo looks like she’s in serious trouble right now though?”
“Hey! Filo-chan clearly hates it! Cut it out!”
“Yaaa!”
Thwack! Filo-tan kicked me clean off her. She then scurried behind Fiancée for cover.
“Filo-tan does not hate it, I say.”
“Yaaa!”
“Yaaa, indeed!”
A salute! Yaaa, indeed!
“Spear Hero, if you cling to Filo-chan one more time, I won’t go easy on you!”
“Thanks, Mel-chan~”
Gah… Fiancée planted herself in my path as if to obstruct me.
“Now now, Motoyasu-kun, calm down.”
“I am calm, I say.”
“Hmm? Kitamura hugged Filo~”
“That was pretty intense, wasn’t it~”
“Fluffy~”
Even the other Filolial-samas didn’t quite get it. But of course. This was an embrace of love, I say.
“Rafumi-chan, couldn’t you extend the guard duty a little longer? This is way too intense a stimulus—Motoyasu-kun’s going to make Filo hate him at this rate.”
“Impossible. My replacement has arrived. Princess Melty, protecting and educating Filo is now your job.”
“Ugh… were you planning to just dump this whole thing on Melty-chan?”
“As an added bonus, so long as the threat known as Spear Hero remains present, Sakura-fication can also be prevented. Problem solved.”
“Let’s make a run for it, Filo-chan! Everyone!”
“Yeah! Filo’s running!”
Filo-tan took off running with Fiancée mounted on her back.
“Ah, wait upー!”
“Everyone, let’s goー! Protect Mel-chan while we play tagー!”
With Filo-tan in the lead, the Filolial-samas all went dashing off.
“Ah, Filo-taaan! Wait for me, I say!”
“W-we can’t just let this happen… That’s it! Motoyasu-kun.”
“What is it?”

Just as I was about to join the chase after Filo-tan, Father stepped in front of me, blocking my path. Were it anyone else, I’d have simply brushed them aside without a second thought, but this was Father, of all people. What could be the matter?
“Well, chasing after Filo is all well and good, but shouldn’t you be paying a little attention to Yuki-chan too?”
Father pointed toward Yuki-chan, who was watching over the Filolial-samas in her role as their leader. When I turned to look… Hiii, Yuki-chan was staring at me with an ominously charged aura!?
“See? Why don’t you show Yuki-chan some attention too.”
“Y-Yuki-chan. This is a misunderstanding, I say. Filo-tan and Fiancée and the others were having so much fun playing that I simply joined in the chase myself. I shall play tag with you too, indeed.”
I mustn’t let Yuki-chan spiral. Deploying every charm technique at my disposal, I wrapped myself in a sparkling aura, loosened my collar just slightly, and cupped Yuki-chan’s face in my hand.
“Motoyasu-sama… you’re right! Yuki was watching over everyone as leader, but Yuki wants to play too!”
“Indeed! Then, Yuki-chan, come chase after me, I say!”
“Yes, ma’am!”
Yes, this way I could disperse Yuki-chan’s ominous aura while still chasing after Filo-tan and the others.
“Then, off we goー, I say!”
“Here I comeー!”
Ufufu… ahahaha… I ran after Filo-tan at a pace just fast enough to keep Yuki-chan from catching up, indeed.

“I’ve got several things I’d like to point out about Motoyasu-kun’s technique for handling Yuki-chan, but… well, Yuki-chan, I think it’s fine for you to close the distance with Motoyasu-kun a bit more, so keep at it!”
“Understoodー!”
“Honestly… he’s really going for it despite the situation, isn’t he.”

“Well, if we were inside Melromarc it’d be a bit more trouble, but things are fairly peaceful out here. Melty-chan accepted the portal request right away too, so we’ve got at least until Rafumi-chan, who’s been playing Ren’s body double, arrives.”

While Itsuki and Father were talking things over, I dashed alongside Yuki-chan. Filo-taaan! My pursuit had begun. I had to flee from Yuki-chan, who was running with a terrifyingly charged aura hanging over her.

After we’d all had our fill of playing tag. Everyone returned to Melromarc together, and Father—with Itsuki perched on his shoulder and Ren left in Luna-chan’s care—turned to Rafumi with furrowed brows.
“So, um… there’s a report I’ve had a vague suspicion about regarding the whole ‘being Ren’s body double’ thing, one I deliberately turned a blind eye to. Mind if I ask about it, Rafumi-chan?”
“What? What is there to ask about? Hey!”
Since the topic concerned something regarding this whole “Rafumi acting as my body double” business, Ren jumped into the conversation.

“No, well… we do hear reports here and there about the heroes being active within the kingdom. Honestly, I was more worried about Itsuki causing some incident that’d spark trouble over here, so I had my people gather information just in case, and this came up along the way.”

Itsuki, playing dumb with an air of total innocence, kept his gaze fixed on the sky while perched on Father’s shoulder. You really do break into noble manors and slave traders’ shops far too often wherever you go, I say. It’s rather odd how, despite claiming to loathe humanity and doing as you please, what you end up causing always somehow turns into helping people.
“And why exactly does that turn into a topic about me—about Rafumi! Answer me!”
“What do you want to know? I can’t answer if you don’t tell me which report you mean.”

Rafumi responded with an attitude so flat it was impossible to tell whether it was feigned innocence or genuine confusion. Father let out a small sigh, then swiftly pulled out the documents in hand—a domestic newspaper, perhaps?—and began speaking while skimming through it.
“This is a newspaper detailing Ren’s activities within the kingdom. Within Melromarc, Ren’s reputation has been skyrocketing lately—he might even be the most highly rated hero right now.”
“Ugh…”
Ren squirmed, mumbling something incoherent, evidently embarrassed to be growing famous for accomplishments that weren’t even his own.
“Next time reward money comes around, it sounds like it’ll be a big one. Well… some of the guild rewards and such, Rafumi-chan’s been donating a portion back to us, but—”
“Is that what you wanted to ask about?”
“No… it’s more that the paper’s full of praise about how you’ve been juggling all sorts of requests, working tirelessly day and night, devoting yourself endlessly to the peace of Melromarc…”

Curious about Father’s meaningful tone, I leaned in to skim the documents in his hands. Itsuki likewise peeked at the papers from his perch on Father’s shoulder. Was there something strange here? Somehow, I felt my own brain cells poring over the material were about to arrive at an answer. Ah… I understood.
“Rafumi-chan… the Ren active within the kingdom—how many of him are there, exactly?”
“What!?”
The moment I arrived at the answer, Father asked Rafumi the very same question. Ren turned to look at Rafumi.
